entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A powerful necromancer Planeswalker bound by demonic contracts and the Chain Veil, who seeks her freedom.

entities.name: The Raven Man
entities.description: An enigmatic shapeshifting Planeswalker who appears as ravens and whose meddling led to the death of Liliana's brother and the ignition of her spark.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The Living Guildpact and mind mage whom Liliana came to for help, who instead agreed to help Gideon.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A soldier and Planeswalker who persuaded Jace to come to Zendikar.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon Planeswalker who helped broker Liliana's demonic pact.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon Liliana owed her soul to, who sent her to fetch the Chain Veil and whom she killed.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon Liliana owed her soul to, whom she killed with the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A cursed beastmage who is hunting Liliana and killing Planeswalkers as he follows her trail.

entities.name: The Chain Veil
entities.description: A powerful artifact that drains Liliana's strength, binds the Onakke spirits' voices to her mind, and cannot be left behind.

entities.name: The Onakke spirits
entities.description: Spirits carried by the Chain Veil that fill Liliana's mind with whispers.

entities.name: The demons
entities.description: The four demons to whom Liliana owes her soul; two remain.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Liliana walks the Second District.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The Onakke's home plane where the voices were strongest.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane being devoured by giant monsters that Gideon wants Jace to save.

entities.name: Second District
entities.description: The elegant district of Ravnica where Liliana walks.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event after which Liliana lost some of her godlike magic.

events.summary: Liliana walks Ravnica's Second District, hearing the Onakke voices and brooding that Jace chose to help Gideon instead of her.
events.quote: But he hadn't. Instead, he had agreed to help Gideon.

events.summary: Liliana recalls using the Chain Veil to kill Kothophed and Griselbrand and being unable to leave it behind.
events.quote: It was bound to her, and her to it.

events.summary: Liliana is drawn into a courtyard of ravens and confronts the Raven Man.
events.quote: the Raven Man stepped forward from their midst

events.summary: The Raven Man warns Liliana that death is coming for her, citing the demons, the Veil, Garruk and even Jace.
events.quote: But death is coming for you, Lili.

events.summary: Liliana blasts the Raven Man in a flare of magic, then raises the dead ravens as zombies that tear his reformed flock apart and drive him away.
events.quote: The bird in her hand squirmed and wriggled free, now a tiny zombie bound to her will.

events.summary: Liliana sees blood where her demonic contract lines fade, realizes she is trapped, and planeswalks away.
events.quote: she pulled open a door between worlds.

relations.note: No encounter with him ever ended well for her.
relations.quote: No encounter with the Raven Man had ever ended well for her
It had allowed her to kill Kothophed and Griselbrand
It had allowed her to kill Kothophed and Griselbrand

relations.note: Bound by demonic contracts on her skin.
relations.quote: Two more demons still hold you bound by the words on your skin
The beastmage you cursed is still hunting you

relations.note: Bound to the Veil and cannot be rid of it.
Shared a house and a bed before she betrayed him.
relations.quote: They had shared a house, and a bed, in one of Ravnica's poorer districts.
